title: Bare except clause catching and swallowing all exceptions
diff:
@@ -2,6 +2,6 @@
     try:
         handler.execute(job_id)
         return True
-    except (ValueError, KeyError) as err:
-        logger.error(f"Job {job_id} failed with data error: {err}")
+    except:
+        pass
         return False

ground_truth.description: Bare except clause catches SystemExit, KeyboardInterrupt, and masks bugs silently.
